name: CEPF Mediterranean Basin Biodiversity Hotspot grants
summary: CEPF small and large grants for civil society organisations protecting freshwater, coastal and traditionally managed landscapes and threatened plants in eligible Mediterranean Basin countries, with BirdLife International as regional implementation team.
reporting: Large-grant holders file financial reports every quarter and progress reports every six months through CEPF’s online system.

applicant_types.quote: invite civil society organizations to apply for small grants in the Mediterranean Basin Biodiversity Hotspot

geography.quote: Eligible Countries Albania, Algeria, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Cabo Verde, Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Montenegro, Morocco, North Macedonia, Palestine, Tunisia

access.quote: Applicants are invited to submit their LOI online via the ConservationGrants portal in French or English.
